calculation_handling.description: The eaves of a roof on an ancillary building may encroach up to 0.3 metres into the required minimum building setback in 10.5.60.20, if the eaves are no closer than 0.15 metres to a lot line.
calculation_handling.gaps: Mixed targets in one unit: the encroachment maximum (encroachment_m, max) and the clearance minimum (encroachment_clearance_m, min); the unit's bound field records the encroachment maximum. Ancillary building eaves are a design input.

units.disclosure: Eaves on a shed or garage may project up to 0.3 m into the setback but must stay 0.15 m from the lot line; not evaluated.

10.5.60.60(1).explanation: The roof eaves of a shed, garage or other ancillary building may extend up to 0.3 m into its required setback, as long as they stay at least 0.15 m from the lot line.
